dispositions.finding: The upper override is validated before mathematical comparison: only tuple/list containers with exactly two values whose exact type is Fraction and whose values are nonnegative pass. NaN, infinities, ordinary floats, integers, booleans, strings, Decimal, None elements, negative Fractions and malformed containers fail closed. Optional upper=None retains documented default behavior. Both supplied valid Fractions and larger valid rational bounds still pass. Seventh test exercises both orders and both bound positions.

findings.finding: Degree-n polynomials have n positive disjoint sign-changing rational brackets, exhausting roots. Polynomial identities agree with exact recurrence. Horner interval arithmetic, rational exponential tail/reciprocal inequalities and total-variation interval differences implement P2 conservatively. Acceptance uses rational arithmetic throughout; conversion to float occurs only after acceptance. Displayed float extrema and upper fields are diagnostics, not outward-rounded runtime enclosures.

Chronological response recursion uses copied prior state, actual irregular/zero intervals and signed currents; derivative product rules and independent suffix assembly agree through order four. Constant-current identities and finite public Taylor value/slope inequalities pass. These are finite diagnostic checks, separate from the mathematical uniform bounds.

All seven current and preserved prior query records are present. The runner reproduces 42 native probe scalar maxima with maximum difference 1.9984014443252818e-15 mV. Public inputs and amplitudes are declared and no truth, fitted trajectories or prior posterior are introduced into fitting; there is no fit objective in this study.

Thirty dense common-anchor numerical controls retain off-diagonal coupling and verify likelihood identity, precision perturbation and transported-gradient local variance inequalities. Report explicitly limits these to conditional local Gauss-Newton covariance; it does not claim posterior coverage or fit-to-fit guarantees.
